mission: CG-GATEWAY-V2.1 — Independent Verification of /v1/responses Wire Protocol & Codex CLI Tool Calls

environment.codex_wire_target: OpenAI Codex CLI v0.154.0 wire protocol

remediated_defects.description: During chunk-by-chunk streaming of custom tool arguments (e.g. {"input": "..."), extract_custom_tool_input fell through to 'return s' when partial JSON prefix syntax had not yet matched the regex. This caused ResponsesStreamAdapter to emit JSON syntax characters ({"input": ") as custom tool input deltas, and subsequently stalled real input value streaming until the input length exceeded 11 characters.
remediated_defects.remediation_action: Routed via native A2A to owning implementer FORGE. Added incomplete JSON prefix guard: if s.startswith('{') or s.startswith('['): return ''. FORGE added regression test test_stream_adapter_custom_tool_fine_grained_json_chunks and committed fix.

1_tool_flattening_and_namespace_normaliz.evidence: Tested deep and mixed namespace structures (functions, admin_tools, empty namespaces, and hosted tools). Verified that custom tools (exec, apply_patch) are synthesized into OpenAI function definitions with parameters: type=object, properties={input: {type: 'string'}}, required=['input'], additionalProperties=False. Verified that hosted server-side tools (web_search, image_generation) are purged completely. Freeform tool names set accurately captures custom tools without leaking standard functions.

2_custom_freeform_tool_delta_streaming.evidence: Verified exact OpenAI Codex wire event sequence: response.created -> response.in_progress -> response.output_item.added (type: custom_tool_call) -> response.custom_tool_call_input.delta -> response.custom_tool_call_input.done -> response.output_item.done -> response.completed. Verified fine-grained token-by-token streaming, complex multiline bash scripts with heredocs and quotes, and unified diff patches.

3_standard_function_call_delta_streaming.evidence: Verified standard function call argument streaming using response.function_call_arguments.delta and response.function_call_arguments.done. Verified parallel tool call streaming with mixed custom and function tools in a single turn, asserting independent index tracking, distinct output_index positions, and complete response.output consolidation.

4_multi_turn_continuation.evidence: Verified end-to-end multi-turn continuation with function_call_output and custom_tool_call_output. normalize_input_to_messages correctly maps tool outputs to MessageItem(role='tool', tool_call_id=..., content=...). Upstream prompt compiler compiles [Tool Result for <name> (<call_id>)]\n<output> into session context, maintaining session continuity across multiple turns.

5_delimiter_sanitization_and_turn_nonce.evidence: Adversarial matrix tested across user messages, system instructions, developer messages, and tool outputs with malicious lookalike delimiters (case variations, spacing variations, nested lookalikes). Sanitization successfully neutralizes unescaped delimiters to \<\<\<... patterns. Cryptographic turn nonce generator verified with 16 bytes (32 hex chars) entropy and zero collisions across 100 consecutive generations.

6_zero_regression_across_existing_suites.evidence: Ran full test suite pytest across all 10 test modules (tests/test_api_multi_turn.py, tests/test_cli_client.py, tests/test_function_calling.py, tests/test_multi_files.py, tests/test_prism_responses.py, tests/test_prism_verification.py, tests/test_responses_api.py, tests/test_session_pool.py, tests/test_sse_parsing.py, tests/test_vision.py). All 98 tests passed with zero failures in 70.71s.
